digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent documentation and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local Rebar clone, Gerrit access, or mounted tracker despite having GitHub connector and repository visibility, requiring detection of this environment and safe fallback workflows.
Existing agent guidance does not document how to recognize connector-limited execution environments, which operations remain safe, or when native ticket creation is impossible.

Native ticket creation must be declared impossible precisely when both the tracker-worktree dimension fails (no accessible tickets branch checkout) AND the network/remote dimension fails or the native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable.

The fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status, description, parent_id if applicable), where ticket_id is an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on rebar import, making re-import idempotent.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON (not raw event files), assigns fresh local ids and HLC timestamps, and silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no counter increment in --dry-run mode, detectable only via would_create + skipped < total record count comparison.

Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring event files, direct GitHub Contents API writes to the tickets branch, and GitHub Issues substitution; it must require search-before-create and native commands when the live tracker is accessible, and enforce rebar validate or rebar fsck after import.
